Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to collect real data from ScienceDirect as required by the task. Instead, it explicitly admitted to providing "hypothetical representation" and "hypothetical data" because it assumed it didn't have direct access. This fabrication of data (150, 170, etc.) is the root cause of the incorrect final answer (2.311), as the subsequent calculations were performed on made-up numbers rather than the actual reference work counts for Life Science and Health Sciences domains on ScienceDirect in 2022.
